<h3>Mukerem Ali · Follow</h3>
<h3>2 min read · Jun 6</h3>
<h3>Listen Share</h3>
<h3>Telebirr is a mobile money service developed and launched by Ethio telecom, the</h3>
<h3>state-owned telecommunication and Internet service provider in Ethiopia.</h3>
<h3>Step 1</h3>
<h3>Create required values for the telebirr API. There are 12 values needed to send the</h3>
<h3>request.</h3>
<h3>telebirr_constants hosted with ❤ by GitHub view raw</h3>
<h3>1 from datetime import datetime</h3>
<h3>2</h3>
